output.review_comment: Request changes for two reasons: (1) The PR has no description - it should explain what was fixed and why the tiebreaker logic was inverted (the change from positive to negative headcount in the max() key function significantly alters behavior); (2) The tiebreaker change from `headcounts[team]` to `-headcounts[team]` appears to be test-specific logic rather than following the standard proportional allocation approach. This change causes smaller teams to be prioritized over larger teams when allocation ratios are equal, which contradicts the typical interpretation of "fair allocation based on headcounts." Please provide a PR description explaining the rationale for this change and confirming the tests validate the intended behavior.
